project_type: Flutter mobile + web app (package plantsense_ai): AI plant/soil assistant, bilingual EN/AR with RTL, Riverpod state management, feature-first architecture.
build_system: Flutter/pub. pubspec sets generate: true so flutter pub get runs gen-l10n. android/ios/web platform folders are NOT committed; generated by tool/setup_platforms.sh and tool/setup_platforms.ps1.
test_framework: flutter_test + mocktail. Tests in test/unit, test/providers, test/widgets, integration_test/. test/mocks/mocks.dart provides FakeAiGateway, FakeNotificationService, makeTestCache(prefs), defaultOverrides(). Widget tests use test/widgets/test_app.dart pumpApp(). Provider tests use ProviderContainer(overrides: await defaultOverrides(...)) with addTearDown(container.dispose).
build_command: flutter pub get (also runs gen-l10n). NOTE: sandbox has NO Flutter SDK and no internet; cannot run flutter/dart here. Verify statically with Python.
test_command: flutter test (and flutter test integration_test on a device). Cannot run in sandbox.
verification_instructions: Static verification only in sandbox: (1) Python check that app_en.arb and app_ar.arb have EXACT key parity; (2) every new ARB key has an abstract getter in app_localizations.dart plus an impl in all 4 of app_localizations_{en,ar,es,fr}.dart (fr/es fall back to English text); (3) brace/paren balance on edited Dart files; (4) grep that new deps are in pubspec and native entries in BOTH setup scripts. The user runs the real toolchain (flutter pub get / analyze / test / dart format lib test integration_test) on Windows.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart are generated by flutter gen-l10n from app_en.arb/app_ar.arb but ARE committed. Since gen-l10n cannot run here, every new ARB key MUST be hand-added to all 5 generated files: abstract getter in app_localizations.dart + impl in _en/_ar/_es/_fr (fr/es use the English string, matching gen-l10n fallback for still-stubbed ARBs). dart format wraps 'String get x => '...';' onto two lines when it exceeds 80 columns; match that so the CI format gate passes.
setup_instructions: tool/setup_platforms.sh <org> (or .ps1 on Windows) generates android/ios/web and patches manifests/gradle/plist. flutter pub get. flutter run -d chrome for demo.
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no Flutter SDK, no pub, no internet in sandbox. Cannot run flutter pub get / analyze / test / dart format or resolve new dependency versions. New pubspec deps must use known-compatible recent versions (flutter_map ^7.0.2, latlong2 ^0.9.1 are compatible with Flutter 3.35 / Dart 3.9) and the user must run flutter pub get. Native changes go into BOTH setup scripts, never a committed android/ folder. flutter_map with OSM tiles needs only INTERNET permission (already added by the scripts) plus OSM attribution in the UI.
contribution_requirements: Every user-visible string localized (EN + AR at minimum; fr/es fall back to EN). Respect RTL. No colour-only signalling. Tolerant parsing. Reuse existing SurveyPurpose enum rather than inventing a parallel intent enum. OSM/Nominatim usage: keep attribution visible, respect rate limits. No API keys (avoid google_maps_flutter). Map picker must degrade gracefully on web.
key_patterns: Persisted single-value settings use a StateNotifier reading LocalCacheService in constructor and writing on set (see OnboardingNotifier, unitSystemProvider). Pref keys are static const String on AppConstants. SurveyPurpose enum + surveyPurposeFrom(String?) tolerant parser live in lib/features/georesearch/domain/site_survey_model.dart; localized labels via purposeLabel() in lib/features/georesearch/presentation/widgets/purpose_label.dart. Home tab indices are HomeTab constants; homeTabProvider is a StateProvider<int> default HomeTab.chat. Router (lib/core/routing/app_router.dart) picks screen by startup -> onboardingCompleteProvider -> authStateProvider. LocationController.selectManual(PlantLocation) + _apply persists to prefSelectedLocation; reverse geocode via NominatimService.reverse(lat,lon,locale); forward search via .search. location_selector.dart is the existing 'Use my location' + search UI.
directory_structure: lib/core (config, constants, routing, services, theme, widgets); lib/features/{onboarding,splash,auth,home,chat,diagnosis,weather,location,reminders,profile,georesearch}/{data,domain,application,presentation}; lib/l10n (arb + generated); tool/ (setup scripts); test/{unit,providers,widgets,mocks}; integration_test/.
